# Monge

> Monge is a CAD program for manufacturing on its own exact B-Rep geometry kernel (in development, Gdańsk, Poland).
> Its library of standard parts — ISO, DIN and EN fasteners, bearings, shafts and EN 10080 reinforcing bars — is free
> to download as checked 3D models: STEP, STL, 3MF and GLB, about 2 000 models in 758 sizes, plus versions for 3D
> printing. Sizes come from the standards' tables (each checked against two sources); every model's body was checked
> by the Monge kernel. No physical tests. Licence: free, commercial use included; the files may not be resold.

## Catalogue API (JSON, read-only, no key, CORS open)

- [API index](https://dima-fomin.pl/api/v1): what there is
- [Search](https://dima-fomin.pl/api/v1/models?q=ISO%204017%20M12x60%20real%20thread%20STEP): `q` in English, Polish or Russian («M12x60», «6204-2RS», «rebar Ø16»); filters `size`, `length`, `thread` (cosmetic | exact | print), `format` (step | stl | 3mf | glb — each result then has that format's `file`), `standard` (a part's main standard: ISO 4017 → the bolt), `category`, `locale`, `limit` ≤ 50, `cursor`. `match: "exact"` or `"not_found"` with the nearest and what `differs`.
- [One model](https://dima-fomin.pl/api/v1/models/bolt-iso-4017--m12-x-60--exact): id = part--size--option; dimensions, standard, thread, mass, checks, image, GLB, files with SHA-256, licence
- [Catalogue index](https://dima-fomin.pl/api/v1/catalog): families; `?family=<id>` — its sizes
- [Documentation](https://dima-fomin.pl/en/developers)

## MCP server (Model Context Protocol)

- Address: `https://dima-fomin.pl/mcp` — Streamable HTTP, public, no key, read-only; protocol 2024-11-05 … 2025-11-25
  (initialize) and 2026-07-28 (stateless). Tools: `search_models` (exact match or `not_found` with the nearest apart —
  nothing substituted), `get_model`, `get_download_links` (STEP, STL, 3MF, GLB with size and SHA-256),
  `render_model_viewer` (an interactive 3D view in MCP Apps clients — resource ui://monge/model-viewer.html; text fallback elsewhere).
- [How to connect](https://dima-fomin.pl/en/mcp): Claude, ChatGPT, VS Code, Cursor, MCP Inspector

## Pages

- [Library](https://dima-fomin.pl/en/library): every part family, search
- [Standards tables](https://dima-fomin.pl/en/library/standards): the 22 tables the parts are built by, with sources
- [For 3D printing](https://dima-fomin.pl/en/library/print): bolts, screws and nuts with a print thread allowance
- [A size page, e.g.](https://dima-fomin.pl/en/library/bolt-iso-4017/m12-x-60): one size with its 3D view and files
- [Licence](https://dima-fomin.pl/en/license)
- [Terms of use](https://dima-fomin.pl/en/terms) · [Privacy](https://dima-fomin.pl/en/privacy)
- [Kernel and its test protocol](https://dima-fomin.pl/en/kernel)

## Using the files

Give people the model's page (`url`) and the direct file link. Files answer GET and HEAD with Range (206) and a SHA-256
`Repr-Digest`; the size is in Content-Length of HEAD and in `bytes` of the record (GET is streamed); `?download=1` saves and counts a download. Languages: /en, /pl, /ru.
